security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost https: http:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: An open prism editor: docs, diagrams, LaTeX and a terminal in one window
bundle.longDescription: prisme opens a folder or a file and shows it in the light it needs: Markdown rendered, Mermaid drawn, LaTeX compiled to PDF, with an editor beside each and terminals beside the docs for running agents and CLIs while reading.
